statement_summary: Security lead designated in writing
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Annual control assessment; quarterly POA&M review
Supplier checklist and security terms in contracts
Retention: Produce Safety 2 years; H-2A 3 years after certification
Unique accounts; no shared tally or HMI logins
MFA for email; FMIS web and mobile; cloud; dealer portal; remote access
Same-day removal at departure; seasonal accounts disabled within 2 days
No always-on supplier access to OT; approved; MFA; logged sessions
Change default passwords before connecting devices
Break-glass accounts tested quarterly
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour (English or Spanish)
Put irrigation and fertigation in a safe state first
Meet notice deadlines in the P08 matrix
Annual tabletop; November manual irrigation drill
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Data inventory including telematics
Monthly farm-held export of regulated records
Isolated immutable backups; quarterly restore tests; versioned PLC backups
Wipe or destroy media with records; shred customer records
Annual bilingual training; phishing exercises; OT training
Call back to confirm any bank or payment change
Approved AI tools only; AI yield estimates are advice only
